summary: Frontend-only multi-viewport E2E testing of SANCTUM MARMORIS (Brutalismo Sacro) on public preview URL. Tested all 14 review items across desktop (1920x900), tablet (820x1180) and mobile (390x844). 100% of functional items pass. Preloader transitions to preloader-out within ~2s, WebGL canvas renders, hero title uses Marcellus serif, custom cursor + ring + label are present on desktop, section-indicator with 4 dots updates active state on scroll, scroll-progress bar renders, 4 catalog tiles render, detail overlay opens/closes, contact form shows error toast on empty submit and success toast on valid submit (form clears). Tablet & mobile correctly switch nav to hamburger drawer with 4 numbered (I/II/III/IV) links that close on click and scroll to section. Mobile catalog renders single column, modal works, contact form responsive, no horizontal scroll, section-indicator hidden <900px. Cursor CSS hide rule (@media hover:none) is correctly authored — verified by source inspection (Playwright cannot emulate hover:none reliably so the live cursor is visible during automation only; will be hidden on real touch devices).
critical_code_review_comments: THREE.Clock deprecation warning logged in console: 'THREE.Clock: This module has been deprecated. Please use THREE.Timer instead.' — non-blocking but worth migrating in Scene.jsx for forward compatibility.

Cursor.jsx renders DOM elements unconditionally; the CSS @media (hover:none) hides them via display:none which is correct. Consider also conditionally not mounting <Cursor/> when navigator.maxTouchPoints>0 to save a tiny bit of JS work on touch devices (nice-to-have, not a bug).

Hero

seed_data_creation: None — static catalog from /app/frontend/src/data/catalog.js; contact submissions persist to localStorage key (MOCKED, frontend-only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All multi-device optimizations confirmed working: (1) Preloader 1.5s -> preloader-out class. (2) Nav uses lg: breakpoint — hamburger shows at <1024px (tablet & mobile), full nav at >=1024px. (3) Mobile drawer has 4 links with Roman numerals I/II/III/IV. (4) Section indicator hidden <900px via CSS (verified display:none @ 390). (5) No horizontal scroll @ 390. (6) WebGL canvas renders on tablet+mobile. (7) Catalog single-column on mobile (items x:24, x:24). (8) Detail modal opens/closes correctly across viewports. (9) Contact form: empty submit -> 'Completa todos los campos requeridos.' toast, valid submit -> 'Solicitud enviada. Te responderemos en 48 horas.' toast and form clears. Custom cursor visible during Playwright runs because emulator does not switch (hover:none); the CSS rule itself is correct (lines 256-266 of /app/frontend/src/index.css). Console only emits a benign THREE.Clock deprecation warning.
rca of the issue: No issues found. App fully functional across desktop/tablet/mobile.
